whoItsFor: Developers and data engineers who need to extract data from websites, from one-off scripts to large concurrent crawls, including sites with anti-bot protection or frequently changing layouts.
useCases: Scraping pages whose layout changes, using adaptive selectors that relocate elements after site updates
Fetching pages protected by anti-bot systems such as Cloudflare Turnstile
Running concurrent, multi-session crawls with pause/resume and automatic proxy rotation
